title: Plan my meals for the week around 120g protein a day.

turns.text: Plan my meals for the week around 120g protein a day.
bubbles: Here's your week, built around ~120g protein a day with realistic, low effort meals: Mon, Greek yogurt + berries breakfast (20g) · chicken burrito bowl lunch (40g) · salmon, rice, broccoli dinner (40g) · cottage cheese snack (15g) Tue, Eggs + toast (20g) · turkey wrap + Greek yogurt (40g) · stir fry with tofu or chicken (40g) · protein shake (20g) Wed, Overnight oats + protein powder (25g) · tuna salad sandwich (35g) · ground beef tacos (40g) · string cheese + almonds (20g) Thu, Greek yogurt parfait (20g) · leftover taco bowl (40g) · baked chicken thighs + potatoes (40g) · shake (20g) Fri, Eggs + avocado toast (20g) · chicken Caesar salad (40g) · shrimp pasta (35g) · cottage cheese (25g) Sat, Protein pancakes (25g) · deli turkey sandwich (35g) · steak + veggies (45g) · Greek yogurt (15g) Sun, Omelet with cheese (25g) · rotisserie chicken bowl (40g) · chili or lentil soup + turkey (40g) · shake (15g) Two tricks that make 120g painless: a 20g protein anchor at breakfast, and one shake or cottage cheese snack daily so dinner isn't doing all the work. Want me to turn this into a grocery list, or keep it lighter and just log meals as you go this week?
